facts.fact: Section 12 of the Digital Services Act, 2025 (No. 22, assented 2025-10-17, commencement by Ministerial Order) requires the Digital Services Authority to establish a standardised Framework for Secure Exchange of Information ensuring secure communication, identity verification, data integrity and interoperability; the Act does not say the framework has been issued, and its date is the assent date.
